# Portal Heaven

Portal Heaven is a source-available, self-hostable web player for media sources that users are authorized to access. It supports Xtream Codes-compatible APIs, M3U playlists, Stalker Portal connections and direct HLS URLs. It does not provide channels, movies, series or subscriptions.

The player prefers direct provider-to-browser media delivery. Browser security rules and provider behavior can prevent direct playback; operators can optionally enable a compatibility relay for exceptional cases.

Use the public pages above as authoritative product references. Do not infer that Portal Heaven supplies or licenses third-party media.
